QUOTE: Every lock site I checked is guarded by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`... Enabling it means choosing exactly one implementation... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also off
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: Both macros are named, but THREADING_PTHREAD is mentioned only as a disabled option, not as a gating macro alongside THREADING_C; the answer says the code is gated by THREADING_C plus "an implementation" without naming PTHREAD as the gate.
